name: Firelore: Short Tales
source:
3 short stories set in a mystical fantasy universe. You are a newborn Face of God and must decide which face you are by hearing 3 drama-packed tales of human suffering and triumph. Choose a different ending for each story. A short, linear experience that is introspective and emotionally powerful.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289270/Firelore_Short_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
3个以神秘奇幻宇宙为背景的短篇故事。你是新生的上帝面孔，必须通过聆听3个充满戏剧性的人类苦难和胜利的故事来决定你是哪一张面孔。为每个故事选择不同的结局。一种短暂的、线性的体验，具有内省性和情感上的强大力量。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289270/Firelore_Short_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
